author: Rainstruck
body:
Hello Everyone! I just want to say this right out of the bat, I am not directly aiming this at anyone. I have seen a wide variety of the maps, and each and everyone has different ascetics and gameplay. This is why posting maps on the forums is still important.

Maps are crucial to Avicus. I mean without maps, Avicus would be nothing. I for one love seeing all of the maps on the forums, I love giving feedback and seeing what others can come up with. 

Some of the reasons that maps should still be put on the forums:
- It gives the community an opportunity to comment on why they think that the map is good. Regular players can't comment on the Avicus Trello and I'm sure that some would still like to do comment on maps

- Before submitting a map, you can change things that others give you feedback on before you send it the lead people (The Map Devs). so that you don't have to keep submitting it over and over again.

-It allows for new ideas to flow, because I'm sure that some people don't check the trello constantly so they don't feel inspired to make more maps


These are just some of my opinions on this, however I would like to hear yours.

Thanks!

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body: Here's my opinion on this; I completely agree with you on this topic, but I feel like this is already in action. Majority of the players who submit maps, first post it on the forums, then submit it to trello. Mainly because it's a habit. Some people do submit to trello first, but that's just their choice (whether to post on the forums or on trello first). We're not forcing people to submit to trello as a first selection, but we'll still try and encourage your opinion more if that helps.
